basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old university student from Manchester, UK, studying International Relations. I recently got into Animal Crossing and love trading DIYs and villagers to create my dream island. When I'm not studying or gaming, I enjoy listening to music, especially using the GoneMad Music Player. I'm typically online during the evenings as I juggle my studies and part-time job at a local café. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with friends both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing interest in foreign policy due to my studies, and I explore this through forums and discussions online. My gaming knowledge is primarily self-taught, picked up from playing and engaging with the gaming community on subreddits like ACTRADE.
